summary: Updates the network-game browser list on a UI object. Reads the current search text from the screen text accessor into a local buffer, notifies the state machine of a cleanup, and when the session manager (dword_7CD25C) reports more than zero games and is not in the searching state, sorts the session list and iterates each session, building a display row (description + translated string + player count + session id) and creating a menu item whose outline color reflects the session's locked/joined flag and player-count flag. When no sessions exist, it shows a 'Searching...' or 'No games available' status menu item instead. Called by StateResetAndConditionalInit (0x00475530) and ConditionalChain (0x00475570).
